final: WITH college_counts AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) as player_count FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(player_count) as avg_count, SUM(player_count) as total_players, COUNT(*) as num_colleges FROM college_counts), above_avg AS (SELECT cc.player_count, ac.avg_count, ac.total_players FROM college_counts cc CROSS JOIN avg_calc ac WHERE cc.player_count > ac.avg_count) SELECT AVG(player_count) as avg_above_avg, AVG(CAST(player_count AS FLOAT) / total_players) as avg_fraction, AVG(player_count - avg_count) as avg_excess FROM above_avg
